tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Run an Ora agent-readiness scan for a domain or MCP server URL. Returns the 0-100 score, grade, and per-layer breakdown; a recent stored result is served from cache instead of rescanning.

url.description: Domain or URL to scan, e.g. stripe.com

tools.name: get_score
tools.description: Read the cached Ora agent-readiness score for a domain without triggering a new scan. A domain with no stored scan returns a next_action pointer to scan_domain.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: List the top domains on the Ora agent-readiness leaderboard, optionally filtered by category.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. Developer Tools
